description: OVHcloud DNS, through its API, of a zone of the account. Each record is written apart, and the zone refreshed after, which serves the changes.

endpoint.description: The API of the account: ovh-eu, ovh-ca or ovh-us, or its https:// URL. Default: ovh-eu.

application_key.description: The application's key, made at the endpoint's /createApp, as https://eu.api.ovh.com/createApp.

consumer_key.description: A consumer key of the application, that allows GET, POST, PUT and DELETE on /domain/zone/<zone>/*: made at the endpoint's /createToken, which makes the three keys at once.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 5m or 1h: 1m at the least. Default: 1h.
